name: Data Access Security Campaign Revocation Failed
description: Sent to a Data Access Security campaign's owner when its revocation processing finishes but one or more access items could not be removed, with a link to the campaign's revocation view.
subject: Action required: Some permissions could not be revoked
body:
Campaign revocation incomplete

Dear $__recipient.name,

Automatic revocation was enabled for your campaign. One or more access items that qualify for revocation were not removed successfully.

Campaign: $campaign.campaignName

Open the campaign details to review the revocation status and retry or ignore the failures.

Thank you for using Data Access Security.
